instruction: Enable live presence indicators to show which team members are currently viewing or editing the document

metadata.explanation: LibreOffice Writer is a desktop application without real-time presence tracking features. It cannot show which users are viewing or editing a document in real-time. This task is infeasible.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly marked as infeasible - LibreOffice Writer is a desktop application that does not support real-time collaborative presence indicators
The instruction requests enabling live presence indicators to show which team members are viewing or editing the document, which is technically impossible in LibreOffice Writer
Proper use of the 'infeasible' evaluator function for tasks that cannot be completed due to technical limitations
